async spec decode: the verify's and the first single-token draft step's CPU seq_lens are computed from host values the GPU correction kernels were given instead of read back from the GPU (each readback waited for all queued work and left the GPU idle while the CPU planned); the drafter's builders wait on an event before reusing pinned staging. Same integers into every FlashInfer plan (VLLM_HOSTFAST_S1=0 / VLLM_HOSTFAST_S2=0 disable; VLLM_HOSTFAST_CHECK=1 reads back and compares)

engine core: automatic GC paused while it has work (young generations collected while the CPU waits for the GPU), and its threads pinned to the highest-capacity cores after startup (VLLM_HOSTFAST_GC=0 / VLLM_HOSTFAST_PIN=0 disable)

one request over the model's 6144 conv channels launched 24 CTAs of 256 channels on a 48-SM GB10; on sm_121 with one request the update kernel now uses 128-channel tiles (48 CTAs). Every channel is computed independently, so no value changes (other devices and batches keep 256).

the tuned routed experts padded K to a multiple of 128, so the down projection's K 1856 became 1920 and every w2 tile streamed and multiplied two all-zero 32-wide K blocks; K now pads only to humming's BF16 pack granule (32), the smallest it accepts. Each element keeps the same K blocks in the same order; the dropped steps were mma(+0, +0, acc), which only turned an acc of -0 into +0, and a signed zero changes no later value's magnitude, logit or token

Confidence-gated draft depth. Drafter: the head screen's token select also computes the draft's top-1 probability over its candidate logits (1 / sum exp(v - max)); inside the proposer's draft loop it counts the kept drafts on device and, once a probability is below MTP_DEPTH_THETA (fixed 0.4), sets a stop flag that the drafter's weight-streaming kernels (GEMV, small GEMM, MoE up and dense down, screen row dot) AND into their weight-load masks, so the loop's remaining passes read no weights and produce zeros. The flag is set only while a draft loop is active and cleared at its end. Verify: the proposer writes kept + 1 to smallk's verify-row count (smallk verify-row hook: rows at or past it take the last valid row's router logits bit for bit, so they add no distinct experts; built by a second agent), and the sampler sets every draft slot at or past count - 1 to -1, which the greedy rejection kernel rejects, emitting row count - 1's own argmax; then every row is valid again. Every forward that is not the one-request verify of 1 + drafts rows resets the count first. Valid rows are their own computation (each row's logits are its own chain; masked rows are finite expert outputs on their own activations), so the emitted tokens are those of a verify at the kept depth, i.e. the target's. MTP_DEPTH_GATE=0 disables; with smallk's verify rows unavailable only the drafting stops early. Carried unchanged from kshitij-hash ca5c19dd-da37-4328-880a-152f8c7b3651.
